coverage: Actual helper output, nonzero exit, cancellation and timeout
Malformed response rejection, bounded transport and no automatic replay
Owned component authentication and tamper rejection
Actual one-file add/update patch planning and line-ending preservation
Refusal of rename, delete, multiple files and linked paths
File hash, writer lease, cancellation and revision fences

offline_windows.boundary: Fresh Windows CI data root. Program-scoped outbound firewall rules covered packaged executables; localhost and the CI runner were not globally disconnected. The dashboard made zero nonlocal requests in the browser test.
not_claimed: Clean installation or upgrade on the owner's actual desktop
Tailscale control from a genuinely remote device

local_regression.environment: Isolated Linux working copy with the actual retained native helper
local_regression.limitation: This is the local working-tree regression tier, not a claim that the complete hosted cross-platform suite passed. The focused tiers overlap and must not be added together as unique test coverage.

review_status: All applicable pending-source-review markers remain. This record preserves observed test results, not independent approval.
